label: MinKNOW data root directory
hint: Root directory containing MinKNOW run output.

label: Pipeline output directory
hint: Root directory for Nextflow pipeline outputs (work directories, reports, results).

label: Biomeme data root directory
hint: Root directory for Biomeme input data.

label: Taxprofiler databases CSV
hint: Path to the databases.csv file defining Kraken2/Bracken databases for the taxprofiler pipeline. Rows: tool, db_name, db_params, db_path. Can also be set via the ODIN_DATABASES_FILE environment variable.

label: Nextflow profile
hint: Leave blank to use per-pipeline defaults (taxprofiler → odin, wf-metagenomics / mpox → odin_epi2me). Set explicitly to force one profile for all pipelines. Can also be set via the NEXTFLOW_PROFILE environment variable.

label: Nextflow config file
hint: Path to the Nextflow config file passed via the -c flag. Defaults to $ODIN_PIPELINE_ROOT/config/odin.config. Can also be set via the NEXTFLOW_CONFIG_FILE environment variable.

label: Nextflow store directory
hint: Directory for nextflow to cache downloaded databases (mpox, wf-metagenomics).

label: Pathogens reference file
hint: Path to the pathogens Excel file used to annotate Kraken2 results with priority and target group. Can also be set via the ODIN_PATHOGENS_FILE environment variable. Optional — Kraken2 results are shown without annotation if not set.

label: Read extraction targets CSV
hint: Path to a CSV file defining organisms available for post-taxprofiler read extraction. Required columns: label, display_name, ref_accession. Optional columns: taxon_taxid (NCBI taxonomy ID for Kraken2 report lookup), taxon_sci_name (scientific name for the output report). Defaults to $ODIN_PIPELINE_ROOT/config/extract_targets.csv. Can also be set via the ODIN_EXTRACT_TARGETS_FILE environment variable.

label: Enlighten data directory
hint: Directory where Feather files are written after post-processing. Enlighten reads from here.

label: Enlighten URL
hint: URL of the Enlighten instance (default: http://localhost). Used for the 'Open in Enlighten' button.

label: Minimum barcode read count (noise threshold)
hint: Barcodes with fewer reads than this are flagged as noise in the dashboard wizard and runs form. Default when empty: 0, which disables the warnings — set a number to enable them, or 0 to turn them off again.

label: Continuation detection time window (hours)
hint: Maximum gap between the end of one run and the start of a later run on the same flow cell for them to be considered a continuation. Default: 48.

label: Device / operator name
hint: A short name identifying this computer and/or operator (e.g. 'Alice / Kenya-laptop'). Recorded on every row created or updated here, and used in sync export filenames. Required before merging data from multiple devices — there is deliberately no default, because a guessed name gets written into permanent records. Can also be set via the ODIN_DEVICE_NAME environment variable, which is the way to make it survive container recreation.
